name: Imazu 03 -- overtaking (own-ship give-way)
description: Canonical Imazu problem 3 (Sawada/Zhai Appendix D reconstruction), reproduced with the exact own-ship/target start positions, headings, and speeds from the reference scenario in Data/Imazu Missions/imazu/imazu/03/03.ini -- kept geometrically identical to the published benchmark so results can be compared directly against other papers using the same Imazu case. ts1 is a slower target ahead that own-ship must overtake.
pass_criteria: Own-ship keeps clear of the slower target it is overtaking and does not cut in front until finally past and clear.
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
